criteria.requirement: Add packaging.record immutable RecordEntry plus parse_record/format_record. Support exact CSV three-column path/hash/size rows, comma/Unicode/newline paths, optional empty hash/size and explicit zero sizes. Strict policy accepts canonical unpadded URLsafe-base64 SHA256/384/512 digests of correct length, rejects unsupported hashes, invalid or negative/bool sizes, wrong columns and duplicate paths. Stable LF output preserves row order and semantic roundtrip. Parsing never accesses disk, imports archive code or verifies actual installed file content; document this scope.

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
